en: A sepia-toned panoramic view of a small European town surrounded by fields and low hills. In the foreground are open meadows and a small shed; behind them lies a dense cluster of houses with gabled roofs. Dominating the skyline to the right is a large church with a tall, slender spire. The style suggests an early 20th‑century photographic postcard. At the bottom margin, handwritten-style text reads "Neustadt i. Sa."
